record.name: Cryogenic Wave
record.narrative: You unleash a sweeping wave of cryogenic energy that flash-freezes everything in its path, leaving a trail of ice and frost. The power manifests as a horizontal avalanche of supercooled particles racing forward, the temperature dropping so rapidly that the air itself crystallizes into a deadly frozen barrier.
record.flavor_text: "Winter is coming... at 60 feet per second." - Arctic Trooper

manifestation.description: sweeping gesture with cryo-emitter creating wave pattern
calculating wave propagation for maximum coverage

base_effect.description: You create a wave of cryogenic energy that deals cold damage to all creatures in a line.

mechanics.notes: Deal 2d4 cold damage to all creatures in a 60-foot line

class_synergies.narrative: Engineers optimize the wave's thermodynamic properties, using advanced coolant dispersal patterns and pressure differentials to create a perfectly uniform freeze-front that maximizes area coverage.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Engineer's wave is 10 feet wide instead of 5 feet.

species_synergies.narrative: Human battlefield innovation transforms Cryogenic Wave into a versatile tool, using environmental factors like humidity and air pressure to amplify the freezing effect beyond standard parameters.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Human wave leaves a trail of ice (difficult terrain) for 10 minutes.

faction_synergies.narrative: Rebel technicians have repurposed starship coolant systems into portable cryo-weapons, their improvised modifications creating wider wave patterns perfect for crowd control against Imperial forces.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Rebel wave pushes Small/Medium creatures 5 feet back.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe the wave as a visible wall of freezing air and ice particles rushing forward. Everything in its path becomes coated in frost - armor cracks from thermal shock, weapons become brittle, and organic tissue suffers immediate frostbite. The ground is left covered in ice.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Cryogenic Wave excels at hitting multiple enemies in a line. The 60-foot range and 2d4 damage affects everyone in the path. Position yourself to catch maximum targets. Remember it hits everything in the line - allies too. Great for corridor fights or lined-up enemies.
narrative_hooks: The wave flash-freezes a water-filled corridor, trapping enemies in ice
A desperate defender uses it to create an ice wall by freezing falling debris
The cold wave reveals invisible enemies as frost outlines their forms

image_generation.base_prompt: A dramatic digital painting of a massive wave of cryogenic energy sweeping across a battlefield. The wave appears as a translucent wall of ice crystals and frozen air, leaving everything in its path covered in thick frost. Multiple enemies are caught mid-freeze, their forms crystallizing as the absolute zero temperatures wash over them. The ground cracks and ice spreads in the wave's wake.
